**Yes, there is a candidate, but it is not corroborated under the run's own rule.**

- Hansen data show a 13.5 ha tree-cover loss event in 2025, about 3.9% of the 345.6 ha property.
- The JRC 2020 forest map classes 98% of that event area as forest in 2020. That is well above the 50% agreement threshold, so the loss appears to be on land that was forest at the 2020 baseline.
- The rule also requires a later year of the series to be observed after the event. The series ends in 2025, the same year as the event, so no later year exists to confirm it.

**Other limits:**
- The MGAP 2021 source was not available.
- Detection is at 30 m resolution with a 0.5 ha minimum event size.
- The engine is early access.

I'd treat this as a candidate to re-check when 2026
